body:
Priya K.: Hey team — unpacked my laptop and during macOS setup it got stuck on 'Awaiting Company Configuration'. MDM says 'Enrollment failed: profile conflict' and FileVault never finished enabling. I need to join calls this afternoon, any quick help?

IT Support: Welcome, Priya! Sorry about that. Can you confirm macOS version (About This Mac) and whether you completed the activation link sent in your welcome email? Also, please connect to internet and keep it plugged in.

Priya K.: macOS Sonoma 14.2. I clicked the activation link and signed in with SSO. Screenshot attached of the MDM error. 

Alex I: Thanks — could be a leftover binding from a previous assignment. Can you paste the serial number? Run: 
```
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial Number"
```
and paste the output here. Also, if you can open Terminal, run `diskutil apfs list` and paste results.

Priya K.: Serial: C02TW0XXXXXX. diskutil output attached.

IT Support: Got it — looks like this unit was previously enrolled to another tenant in our MDM console (shows as claimed). That explains the conflict. We'll need to unclaim it in the MDM portal and reassign it to you. Doing that now, ETA ~15–20m.

Lena (Onboarding): I'm unassigning it now and re-triggering DEP enrollment. Priya, when I reassign, reboot the Mac and try the setup again. If it still refuses, we can provision a temporary local admin for you to finish meetings.

Priya K.: Thanks! Do I lose any FileVault steps if I get a temp admin?

Alex I: FileVault is handled by MDM policy once enrolled — the recovery key is escrowed. If we give you a temp admin to complete onboarding, you may see a FileVault enable prompt, but the real encryption + escrow won't finalize until the device is enrolled. We'll coordinate so you don't encrypt in a way that prevents the MDM from taking control.

Lena (Onboarding): Creating a short-lived admin now (expires 24h). Please run the following to create a temp admin (paste into Terminal):
```
sudo dscl . -create /Users/tempadmin
sudo dscl . -create /Users/tempadmin UserShell /bin/bash
sudo dscl . -create /Users/tempadmin RealName "Temp Admin"
sudo dscl . -create /Users/tempadmin UniqueID 510
sudo dscl . -create /Users/tempadmin PrimaryGroupID 80
sudo dscl . -passwd /Users/tempadmin S3cur3P@ss!
sudo dscl . -append /Groups/admin GroupMembership tempadmin
```
Make sure to change the password after first login. This account will be removed by IT within 24 hours.

Priya K.: Done — I can log in as tempadmin. Setup progressed past the stuck screen and now it's asking for FileVault to be enabled. Should I enable it?

Alex I: Wait 5–10 min while I confirm the MDM re-assignment. If the device is enrolled before you enable FileVault, the recovery key will be escrowed automatically. If you enable encryption before enrollment, we'll need to coordinate to ensure we can escrow the key manually.

IT Support: Enrollment succeeded on our portal — device shows active and assigned to Priya. Please reboot and sign in as your corp SSO user (not tempadmin). Then check System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault. If it still prompts, enable it now — the MDM should capture the key within a few minutes.

Priya K.: Rebooted, signed in with SSO, FileVault started enabling and I got a prompt 'Your recovery key will be saved to your organization's management system'. :partyparrot: All good.

Sam M: Awesome — welcome aboard, Priya! If you need VPN certs or dev tooling, ping me.

Lena (Onboarding): We'll remove the tempadmin account later today. Priya, you should now have normal user + admin elevation via company SSO for any installs. If anything weird pops up (kernel extension prompts, notarization warnings), drop here or DM IT.

Priya K.: Thanks everyone — super fast. Appreciate it! :heart:

onboarding-bot: Device assignment complete — Priya K assigned MacBook Pro (C02TW0XXXXXX) to new-hires pool. Welcome to Redwood Inference!"
